summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring float fix), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_patch_without_coordinates and test_missing_len). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Deviations: test_loading_array checks shapes, exact coordinates, and per-patch constant shift instead of literal patch values, because I could not compute the seeded values without running code. The multi-worker check compares coordinates exactly and values by shift-consistency, not against single-process values. Pre-existing lines over 120 chars in utils.py get_valid_patch_size were left alone. Next step: run pytest on tests/test_grid_dataset.py and capture literal values if desired.
